You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 7b4ff6dd231f6742c1a75a62b431af64fa6e7a20 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dietmar Eggemann <dietmar.eggemann@arm.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Feb 2017 13:31:31 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] Do not use json-c's is_error() any more

In json-c-0.12 is_error() is defined in bits.h which is exported via
json.h. However, json-c's master branch contains commit d4e81f9ec827
which declares bits.h deprecated and removes the export via json.h.

Replace the use of is_error() with its trivial implementation to be
able to get rid of this single dependency towards the deprecated
bits.h.

This fixes an issue introduced by commit 17dd99c72a12 ("Clean-up header
file inferno") which removed #include <json-c/bits.h> from
src/rt-app_parse_config.c.

Cc: Olav Haugan <ohaugan@codeaurora.org>
Signed-off-by: Dietmar Eggemann <dietmar.eggemann@arm.com>
Acked-by: Vincent Guittot < vincent.guittot@linaro.org>
---
 src/rt-app_parse_config.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/rt-app_parse_config.c b/src/rt-app_parse_config.c
index c6086f4..a6e3b59 100644
--- a/src/rt-app_parse_config.c
+++ b/src/rt-app_parse_config.c
@@ -895,7 +895,7 @@ get_opts_from_json_object(struct json_object *root, rtapp_options_t *opts)
 {
 	struct json_object *global, *tasks, *resources;
 
-	if (is_error(root)) {
+	if (root == NULL) {
 		log_error(PFX "Error while parsing input JSON");
 		exit(EXIT_INV_CONFIG);
 	}
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The root cause of the bug was the removal of the `#include <json-c/bits.h>` directive from the source file `src/rt-app_parse_config.c`, which was needed to use the `is_error()` function to check for errors in the JSON object. As the `is_error()` function was defined in a deprecated header that was removed from the current implementation of json-c, its usage led to an error during compilation. The patch corrects this by replacing the use of `is_error()` with a simple null check (`root == NULL`), thus removing the dependency on the deprecated `bits.h` header and preventing the error.

    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug was the removal of the `#include <json-c/bits.h>` directive from the source file `src/rt-app_parse_config.c`, which was needed to use the `is_error()` function to check for errors in the JSON object. As the `is_error()` function was defined in a deprecated header that was removed from the current implementation of json-c, its usage led to an error during compilation. The patch corrects this by replacing the use of `is_error()` with a simple null check (`root == NULL`), thus removing the dependency on the deprecated `bits.h` header and preventing the error.
